newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, March 10-16 - Bourgas - 20 Vessels in port operating of which 13 loading (1 baryte concentrates, 5 fertiliser, 4 steel, 1 wood, 1 metal, 1 benzene). 4 Discharging (1 salt, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 wheat, 1 petrol). 1 Discharging/loading containers, 2 empty vessels. 8 Waiting in roads of which 3 to load (1 chemicals, 1 steel, 1 galvanic coils). 1 Tanker to discharge, 2 vessels to discharge/load (1 cars, 1 containers), 2 empty vessels. 26 Due of which 14 to load (1 petrol, 1 chemicals, 5 steel, 1 cotton, 1 corn, 2 fertiliser, 1 wood, 1 coke, 1 general cargo, 1 metals). 7 To discharge (1 petrol, 1 lead/zinc, 1 coal, 1 rails, 1 zinc concentrates, 2 iron ore). 5 To discharge/load (4 containers, 1 containers/cases).

Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik - 31 Vessels operating of which 17 loading (1 soda/fertiliser, 2 soda, 1 clinker, 1 cigarettes/food, 3 fertiliser, 1 kaolin/granite, 3 quartz sand, 1 tsp, 1 cement, 1 sas, 1 glass, 1 magnetite). 6 Discharging (1 phosphorite, 1 coal, 1 potassium chloride, 1 granite, 1 soya fodder, 1 coal/coke). 1 Discharging/loading coke/clinker, 3 discharging/loading trucks/containers, 4 discharging/loading containers. 4 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to load cement, 3 cargo not nominated.

March 17 - Varna - No strikes. Varna east - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 5 vessels awaiting orders. Varna west - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Lesport tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - No strikes. Bourgas east - 10 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 4 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 26 due. Bourgas west - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Tanker port - 1 Loading at berth, 1 discharging.

CROATIA, March 17 - Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 5 under repair/dry-docked, 7 due. Zadar - One vessel due. Sibenik - One vessel discharging at berth. Split - One vessel discharging at berth. Ploce - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Pula, Rasa, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, March 18 - Limassol - Three container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 10 Vessels due 19/3 of which 5 containers, 2 conventional vessels, 3 passenger vessels, no delays expected. Larnaca - One container vessel loading/discharging at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth, 2 conventional vessels due 19/3, no delays expected.

ESTONIA, March 18 - No labour problems, no berthing delays. Tallinn - City port - 3 Vessels loading at berth (1 map, 1 timber, 1 pig-iron), 2 liners, 6 vessels due. Kopli - 2 Vessels loading at berth (1 sawn timber, 1 fertiliser. 2 Discharging at berth (1 meat, 1 fish). 7 Vessels due. Muuga - 11 Vessels loading at berth (5 fuel oil, 1 timber, 1 peat, 1 fertiliser, 3 general cargo). 5 Discharging at berth (1 fish, 1 bananas, 3 general cargo). Parnu - Five vessels loading at berth (1 wood granules, 2 briquettes, 2 timber), 3 vessels due.

ITALY, March 18 - Naples - One gas tanker etb 18/3, 1 bulk carrier etb 19/3. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa - commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays, 13 vessels berthed, 5 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - 1 Vessel in roads, 1 berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed, 5 under repair. Leghorn - No vessels in roads, no delays, 42 vessels berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel berthed. Gaeta, Naples, Salno, Palermo, Sarroch, Ravenna, Venice - No vessels, no delays. Augusta - Oil harbour - No vessels, no delays. Syracuse - Oil harbour - No vessels, no delays. Taranto - One vessel in roads. Trieste - One tanker in roads.

LATVIA, March 18 - No strikes at any port. Ventspils - Four vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 steel loader, 1 pig-iron loader, 1 beer discharger, 1 sugar discharger,loader. No vessels waiting, no delays, 16 vessels due. Riga - 14 Vessels in port, all operating, of which 5 timber loaders, 1 scrap metal loader, 2 container loaders, 2 tanker loaders, 2 steel loaders, 1 mop loader, 1 fruit discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, 19 vessels due. Liepaja - Eight vessels in port of which 7 operating, 1 waiting, no delays, 2 vessels due.

LITHUANIA, March 17 - Klaipeda - 13 Vessels loading of which 1 scrap, 3 fertiliser, 3 metal, 1 cement, 1 timber, 1 steel coils, 1 steel sheet, 1 general cargo, 1 other vessel. 3 Vessels discharging of which 1 fish, 1 fertiliser, 1 fish meal. 1 Vessel loading/discharging, 3 vessels in roads, 40 vessels due.

POLAND, March 18 - Szczecin - 54 Vessels loading at berth, 24 discharging at berth, 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 1 vessel bunkering. 9 Under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders, 84 due. Gdynia - Eight vessels operating of which 4 general cargo loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth (1 general cargo, 1 bulker, 2 grain). 2 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 34 due. Gdansk - Six vessels operating of which 4 loading at berth (2 bulkers, 1 general cargo, 1 coal). 2 Discharging at berth (1 bulker, 1 grain). 2 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 2 bulkers awaiting turn, 23 vessels due.

PORTUGAL, March 17 - Leixoes - 13 Vessels operating of which 8 general cargo, 5 containers, 2 handy-size container vessels awaiting berths totalling 28,461 dwt. Vacant places, 4 piers with cranes, 2 without cranes. Sines - One vessel in port loading propylene, 1 waiting to load aromatic mixture. 7 Vessels due of which 5 to load (1 propyne, 1 crude oil, 1 butane, 1 ethylene, 1 gasoil/gasoline/jet fuel). 2 To discharge (1 naphtha, 1 metallic structures).

March 18 - Lisbon - 69 Vessels in port of which 1 loading at berth, 15 discharging at berth, 4 loading/discharging at berth, 2 loading at anchor. 17 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 6 awaiting orders, 21 miscellaneous, 12 due. Leixoes - Two vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/dry-docked. 7 Vessels due of which 2 to discharge, 4 to load, 1 for repair/dry-dock.

ROMANIA, March 17 - Constantza - 25 Vessels operating of which 10 general cargo (8 loading, 2 discharging), 4 bulkers (2 loading, 2 discharging), 5 tankers (3 loading, 2 discharging), 2 containers (1 loading, 1 discharging), 1 cement, 3 bagged cargo (all loading). 3 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 general cargo, 1 bulker (both to load), 1 bagged chemicals to discharge. Constantza south (Agigea) - Three general cargo, 1 container vessel loading, 1 bulker discharging. Mangalia - No vessels operating. Midia - Four livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - March 17 - 22 Vessels operating of which 14 loading (5 non-ferrous metals, 3 fertiliser, 2 containers, 1 cellulose, 1 coal, 2 general cargo). 8 Discharging (3 frozen chicken, 2 containers, 1 bananas, 2 frozen meats. 9 Vessels awaiting operations, 10 due. March 18 - No strikes. Kaliningrad - Nine vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 urea loader, 1 ferrous metal loader, 1 aluminium loader, 1 sunflower seed loader, 1 scrap metal loader, 1 meal discharger, 1 meat discharger, 1 animal fodder discharger, 1 container discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, none due. Vyborg - Six vessels in port of which 5 operating, 1 waiting. No delays, 4 Vessels due.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - March 17 - 20 Vessels operating of which 11 loading (1 coal, 3 steel, 1 cast iron, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 aluminium, 2 sunflower seeds, 2 fertiliser). 9 Discharging (2 rice, 2 sugar, 2 various, 1 citrus, 1 copper pipes, 1 bananas/coconuts)/. 18 Vessels waiting in roads of which 8 to load (2 scrap, 1 barley, 2 steel, 1 zinc, 1 aluminium, 1 coal). 10 To discharge (4 sugar, 3 rice, 1 barytes, 1 citrus, 1 luggage). 36 Vessels due of which 20 to load (2 scrap, 1 cast iron, 11 steel, 1 flowers, 1 tin, 2 copper, 1 aluminium, 1 zinc). 14 To discharge (1 maize, 1 sugar, 1 rice, 6 citrus, 1 haricots, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 equipment, 2 luggage). 2 To discharge/load containers. Oil terminal - March 18 - 1 Vessel berthed to load crude oil, 2 tankers waiting in roads of which 1 to load diesel oil, 1 crude oil. 5 tankers due to load of which 4 crude oil, 1 diesel oil.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - March 18 - 10 Vessels operating of which 2 alumina, 1 apatite, 1 non-ferrous metal, 1 steel, 1 anode paste, 1 coal, 1 grain, 2 cabotage, 2 apatite loaders, 4 alumina dischargers awaiting berths. 7 Vessels due during the week of which 5 loaders (1 non-ferrous metals, 1 steel, 1 scrap, 2 apatite), 2 dischargers (1 anode paste, 1 cabotage).
SPAIN, March 18 - Cadiz - 19 Vessels operating of which 4 ro-ros, 1 tobacco, 2 shipbuilding materials, 1 semolina, 1 iron, 1 sand, 1 wheat, 8 under repair, no delays.

TURKEY, March 17 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 6 Vessels operating of which 3 containers, 2 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro, no berthing delays. Galata - 8 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 13 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. March 18 - Mein - 21 Vessels operating of which 7 loading (1 flour, 1 pumice stone, 1 containers, 1 general cargo, 1 cement, 2 manure). 9 Discharging (1 pvc, 1 pulses, 1 mosaic, 1 paraxylene, 2 vetches, 1 wood, 1 sesame, 1 sunflower oil). 5 loading/discharging (2 vehicles, 3 containers). 13 Vessels at anchorage. Iskenderun - Sariseki terminal - 3 Dischargers (2 fertiliser, 1 phosphate), 2 vessels at anchorage. Yazicilar terminal - 1 Vessel loading building iron, 1 discharging scrap iron, 2 vessels at anchorage.

Ekinciler terminal - 1 Vessel loading building iron, 2 discharging scrap iron, 2 at anchorage. Isdemir terminal - 2 Vessels loading building iron, 2 discharging coal, 1 at anchorage. Toros terminal - 2 Vessels discharging (1 corn, 1 fertiliser), 1 at anchorage. Botas terminal - 1 Vessel at anchorage. Mersin - 20 Vessels operating of which 4 loading (1 flour, 1 general cargo, 2 fertiliser). 8 Discharging (1 raw materials, 1 tiles, 1 oil cake, 1 oil cake/corn, 1 paraxylene, 1 general cargo, 1 soya bean oil, 1 sunflower oil). 8 Loading/discharging (1 legumes,pumice stone, 1 vehicles, 6 containers). Free zone piers - 1 Vessel discharging polystyrene. Seka - No vessels.

UKRAINE, March 17 - Mariupol - Six vessels loading at berth (1 sunflower seeds, 3 metal products, 1 sulphur, 1 containers), 1 vessel under repair/dry-docked. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (2 sulphur, 1 metal products, 1 fertiliser, 1 containers). 12 Floating storehouses (10 fertiliser, 2 sulphur). 18 Vessels due of which 11 to load (3 metal products, 6 sulphur, 1 coal, 1 containers). 1 To discharge general cargo/load metal products, 6 to discharge (1 alumina, 1 general cargo, 4 containers). Kerch - Six vessels under repair/dry-docked, 1 due to discharge general cargo. Berdyansk - Two vessels loading at berth (1 clay, 1 sunflower seeds). 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load ore, 1 vessel due 19/3 to load fertiliser.

Mariupol - Six vessels in port operating of which 5 loading (1 sunflower seeds, 1 slabs, 1 fertiliser, 2 steel), 1 loading/discharging containers. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load (1 steel, 3 fertiliser). 1 To discharge/load containers. 19 Vessels due of which 10 to load (2 steel, 6 fertiliser, 1 ferrous metals, 1 coal). 2 To discharge (1 alumina, 1 equipment). 6 To discharge/load containers, 1 cargo not nominated. Odessa - 18/3 - 21 Vessels in port operating of which 5 loading (1 fuel oil, 3 metal, 1 sunflower seeds). 1 Discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging gasoil, 5 discharging citrus, 1 discharging tea. 6 Under repair, 2 passenger vessels. 13 Vessels waiting in roads of which 8 to load (4 sunflower seeds, 2 metals, 1 fertiliser, 1 fuel oil). 3 To discharge gas oil, 1 waiting, 1 under arrest. 14 Vessels due of which 10 to load (2 metals, 1 diesel oil, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 sugar, 1 wat, 1 peas, 1 paper, 1 cellulose, 1 chemicals). 1 To discharge bananas, 3 to discharge/load containers

YUGOSLAVIA, March 18 - Nine vessels berthed of which 2 discharging (1 bananas, 1 general). 7 Loading (4 steel coils, 2 aluminium, 1 hollow section). 5 Ferries, no delays. Zelenika, Bijela - One vessel laid up, no commercial operations, 3 vessels under repair.
